principles: Precise functional interfaces and expressive experiences share semantic foundations.
Use existing components before adding variants or local extensions.
Keep business logic and financial arithmetic outside the design system.
agentRules: Query available components and their status before implementing.
Use public semantic tokens; reference palette tokens are internal.
Do not invent component imports or unsupported props.
Do not copy Reshaped source or claim API parity.
Do not use Tailwind as a required dependency.
Use documented composition and public className entry points; do not target internal selectors.
Treat experimental APIs as unstable and never describe planned capabilities as implemented.
For bespoke motion document purpose, interruption and reduced-motion behavior.
A local exception needs rationale, scope and a review date in the consuming repo.
limitations: Raw-value checks cover only font weight, focus outline, box shadow and overlay background in component CSS; broader static enforcement is planned.
Design-tool mappings cover tokens only (Sketch and Figma); no component symbols are mapped.
This release has ten experimental component contracts: Button, TextField, Dialog, Theme, Field, Checkbox, Select, Tabs, Popover and DropdownMenu.
